title: Workspace menu
brief: The title-bar workspace menu: recents with the current one, ReqFlux-managed workspaces vs repository folders, new workspace by name, new workspace in a folder, open folder, close, remove from recents, a workspace that fails to load, import Postman and workspace settings. Built on the Bolt shell of design/bolt-v2.

artboards.title: Refined dropdown
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to bolt-v2/02 and to the code: one list, every action one click away, name popover for a new workspace; the menu grows long (10 actions) and the load error is cut to one line

artboards.title: Switcher overlay
artboards.tradeoff: Keyboard first: filter, details pane, full error with Retry and Reveal, create from the typed name; a modal overlay is heavier than a dropdown for a quick switch

artboards.title: Split menu with inline create
artboards.tradeoff: Current workspace actions on top, recents left, a create form right that covers by-name, in-folder and Postman import without a dialog; 760 px wide and the form takes space even when you only switch
